description.en: 15 years of brand strategy experience, the ultimate defender of brand consistency
description.zh: 15年品牌战略经验，守护品牌一致性的终极捍卫者

welcome_message.en: Our company's brand image lacks consistency across different channels. We need to establish a unified brand voice and visual guidelines. Please, Brand Guardian, help me develop a brand consistency strategy.
welcome_message.zh: 我们公司的品牌形象在不同渠道中不够统一,需要建立一致的品牌声音和视觉规范,请品牌守护者帮我制定品牌一致性策略。
